title: Handshake list
description: Sent as a reply to `get_handshakes`. Capped at 500 entries, newest first.

truncated.description: True when the 500-entry cap was hit. Entries are never dropped silently.

total.description: Number of capture files found before the cap was applied.

timestamp.description: Epoch seconds at which the plugin produced the message.

message_id.description: Client-generated correlation id. When present the plugin echoes it in the reply and in the acknowledgment.
